conviction_note: Zero: the only lodgement that fits a 28-30 Sep date for this issuer is the statutory FY26 Annual Report. Its cash figure (A$58.9m at 30 June, no debt, about A$25m more needed to reach FID) was published in the 31 Jul 2026 Appendix 5B, the next 5B is not due until late October, and the two previous annual-report days moved +2.77% and +2.14%, both inside rising tapes. Nothing dated lands in the window that the price does not already hold, so there is nothing to size against a +2.52 lean that is mostly the ASIC short-squeeze term.
bar: Cash burn against stated runway, per the quarterly_report_only filer type: A$58.9m cash and listed investments at 30 Jun 2026, no debt, management stating that the runway reaches the targeted Gonneville FID (H1 2028) with no immediate need to raise equity or debt (https://www.fool.com.au/2026/07/31/chalice-mining-advances-gonneville-holds-59m-cash-at-june-2026/, summarising the ASX June 2026 Quarterly Activities & Cashflow Report https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/displayAnnouncement.do?display=pdf&idsId=03120411). A 22 Sep 2026 review puts the capital still needed to FID at about A$25m (https://discoveryalert.com/analysis/chalice-mining-gonneville-project-update-september-2026/). There is no street EPS bar. An annual report restates the June balance sheet, so its print_vs_bar is 0 by construction.
filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only, and the ASX archive confirms it: 11 quarterly activities and cashflow reports over three years, no 4D and no 4E. Half-year accounts go in as a plain 'Half Year Accounts' lodgement (13/03/2026 17:53) and the annual accounts as 'Annual Report to shareholders' (26/09/2025 12:21, 26/09/2024 16:41). The vendor's 28 Sep row is therefore almost certainly the FY26 Annual Report and not a cash-flow print, because the September 2026 quarterly came out on 20 Oct in 2025 and on 29 Oct in 2024. So I hunted for (a) anything in the annual accounts not already disclosed in the June 5B, such as going-concern language, an impairment or a reserves change, and (b) any dated catalyst inside the window: Deep Blue assays, pilot plant start, a streaming or partner deal, a financing or a trading halt.
event_check: The ASX 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=CHN&timeframe=Y&year=2026) has no forward notice. Its latest rows are the 24/09/2026 AGM notification (AGM on 20 Nov 2026) and a 25/09/2026 Vanguard Form 603. The event is PROBABLE, not confirmed. The Annual Report is statutorily due by 30 Sep, and in both prior years it followed the AGM notification within about 4 to 13 days, lodged on 26 Sep (2025 archive: https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=CHN&timeframe=Y&year=2025; 2024: https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=CHN&timeframe=Y&year=2024). 26 Sep 2026 is a Saturday, so the lodgement falls on 28, 29 or 30 Sep. A 30 Sep lodgement would be outside the window. Either way this is not a 4C/5B and not a results print, and the baseline's reaction history (11 quarterlies) does not measure it.
session_check: Baseline amc, not independently settled. The prior two annual reports went in at 12:21 (in session, 2025) and 16:41 (after the close, 2024), so the release is not reliably pre-open. That does not matter at a zero size.
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short is 3.64% as of 2026-09-21, against 3.56% on 2026-09-14 (+0.08pp, mildly building), with a 4-session lag. That is a moderate position on an untruncated register, not a crowded one. Price fell -9.89% over 20d and -1.2% over 5d. The +2.52 priced lean is mostly the short_squeeze term (+2.18). A statutory annual report restating known cash is not a squeeze catalyst, so I have no finding that either agrees with the lean or beats it. The only other flow is Vanguard crossing 5.007% on 21 Sep through small index-sized buys on 18/21 Sep (Form 603, https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/displayAnnouncement.do?display=pdf&idsId=03143698). That is passive and already public.

outside_window.finding: The September 2026 Quarterly Activities & Cashflow Report (Appendix 5B), the real cash-burn print for this filer type, is due in late October by precedent (20/10/2025, 29/10/2024). It cannot land in a 28-29 Sep window. It is unsized because there is no evidence yet on burn against the A$58.9m June balance.
Gonneville binding streaming, royalty or ECA financing. As of 21 Sep 2026 none had been disclosed and talks are described as exploratory, so there is no date and no size.

Deep Blue follow-up assays after the 08/09/2026 'Copper-silver-gold system intersected at Deep Blue' release. They are undated and unsized, and they are exploration news with no path to the Gonneville valuation.

searched_and_found_nothing: ASX 2026 archive for a Notice of Results, trading halt, capital raise, Appendix 3B or guidance change in the last 12 months: none. The only issues are routine employee incentives and unquoted securities.
The June 2026 quarterly for a runway warning: management says the runway reaches FID with no immediate need to raise (fool.com.au summary; the ASX PDF is encrypted and could not be parsed locally).
Reactions on prior annual-report days: 2024-09-26 amc then +2.77% next session and 2025-09-26 +2.14% in session, both inside strong uptrends. That is no evidence of an annual-report reaction.

Cause of the +11.97% move on 2026-08-20: no ASX announcement that day and no press explanation found (https://kalkine.com.au/news/mining/chalice-mining-asxchn-rallies-as-buyers-return-to-the-gonneville-story). It has since fully reversed and is worth 0.
Dated late-September catalysts: pilot plant start is 'Q3 CY26' / H2 2026 with no date, and the EPA first-draft ERD targets late 2026. Neither is inside the window.
Director dealing: Appendix 3Y notices were lodged 09/07/2026 and 04/06/2026 and there are none since. No insider signal into the window.
baseline_tension: I found nothing, so there is no tension with the +2.52 lean (mostly short_squeeze) or the -9.89% 20d run-up. The zero reflects that the event is a non-informative statutory report, not a judgement on the lean.
